editorial:
Ever wonder if a simple shape could have a broken heart? You get to see exactly that in this quirky little short. It follows a straight line who is totally head over heels for a tiny dot. The vibe is super playful and smart, using basic math shapes to tell a story about love and rejection. It feels like a weirdly charming date where you are just watching these shapes try to figure out their feelings on a blank screen. It is a really cute setup that makes you root for the underdog line even though he is just a streak of ink.

What really hits home is how the animation makes these flat shapes feel like real people with big emotions. The pacing is snappy, and the humor is top-notch, though the sadness of the love triangle might sting a bit. If you enjoy creative art or just want something short and sweet, you have to check this out. Since it is an older piece, you should look for a high-quality restoration.
endingExplained: After the line tries everything to win over the dot, he discovers she is actually in love with a wild, curvy squiggle. The line gets totally heartbroken because he can never be curvy like that. In the end, the line realizes he cannot change who he is. He accepts his fate as a straight line, and the story wraps up with a lesson about loving yourself even when someone else does not love you back.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves creative animation and short stories about love.
